title: Enterprise E-commerce Platform
tagline: E-commerce experience through strategic page enhancements
summary: Product detail pages, product grids and category grids for a large-scale e-commerce platform: pixel-accurate, reusable React and Next.js components built from Figma and Zeplin designs.
overview: Frontend engineering for a large-scale e-commerce platform, focused on the pages that drive conversion: Product Detail Pages, Product Grids and Category Grids.

I turn Figma and Zeplin designs into reusable, responsive React and Next.js components, and over time moved into a leadership role, guiding developers and reviewing code while still building the most complex features.

points: Developed and enhanced Product Detail Pages, Product Grids and Category Grids.
Implemented new features and optimized existing components for usability, maintainability and performance.
Converted Figma and Zeplin designs into reusable, responsive, pixel-accurate React and Next.js components.
Built custom components with consistent behaviour across pages and device sizes.
Guided developers, reviewed code and kept implementation aligned with project standards.
Continued hands-on delivery of complex, critical features.

achievements: Grew from developer to module lead on the project.
Reusable component library shared across key commerce pages.
